text: dsh-web-search-openai 为 DSH Web 的 web_search 接入 OpenAI Responses 原生网页搜索。插件注册搜索 provider，将用户查询发送到配置的 Responses endpoint，再把回答文本和 URL 引用映射为 DSH 搜索结果。它要求响应包含原生搜索调用及可用的 HTTP(S) 引用，并去重链接、保留标题。随包 endpoint 指向 llmapi.imedloop.com；使用时需配置 GPT_API_KEY 和支持原生 Web Search 的模型。

dsh-web-search-openai connects DSH Web search to OpenAI Responses native Web Search. It sends queries to the configured endpoint and returns answer text with deduplicated HTTP(S) citations as DSH results. The bundled endpoint is llmapi.imedloop.com; configure GPT_API_KEY and a compatible model.

dsh-web-search-openai 的功能「Responses 搜索」：将 DSH 查询发送到支持原生 Web Search 的 Responses endpoint，并把回答及去重的 HTTP(S) 引用作为搜索结果返回。
dsh-web-search-openai 的功能「凭据解析与请求记录」：每次搜索解析配置的凭据引用，构造 Responses 请求，并可将不含密钥的 endpoint 和请求正文记录到当前会话事件。
dsh-web-search-openai 使用前须知：搜索会把查询和 Bearer 凭据发送到配置的 Responses endpoint；随包配置的主机是 llmapi.imedloop.com。
dsh-web-search-openai 使用前须知：搜索需要 GPT_API_KEY 凭据引用（或显式配置的 apiKey）；代码支持从 DSH credentials 服务或启动环境解析该凭据。

dsh-web-search-openai README · dsh-web-search-openai：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A standalone DeepSeek Harness bundle that keeps the stable `web_search` tool and replaces only its search backend with an OpenAI Responses native Web Search provider. The provider sends `tools: [{ "type": "web_search" }]`, maps `url_citation` annotations to DSH `WebSearchResult.sources`, and exposes the stable provider id `openai-responses`.

dsh-web-search-openai README · dsh-web-search-openai：The bundled patch is configured for `https://llmapi.imedloop.com/v1/responses`, model `gpt-5.6-sol`, and credential reference `GPT_API_KEY`. The endpoint must implement native Responses Web Search; ordinary Responses text generation or function calling is insufficient. See the [official OpenAI Web Search guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/tools-web-search).

dsh-web-search-openai README · Install：In the DSH Web UI plugin field, paste only:

```text

```

From a terminal:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Alberssssss/dsh-web-search-openai
```

For local development, build and add this checkout instead:

dsh-web-search-openai README · Install：Restart the `web` profile Host, refresh the browser connection, and create a new session. A page refresh alone does not reload Cordis plugins, and an existing session retains the composition with which it was created.

dsh-web-search-openai README · Runtime flow：```text
model calls DSH web_search
  -> ctx.web selects openai-responses
  -> provider resolves GPT_API_KEY
  -> POST /v1/responses with native web_search

The provider rejects a successful HTTP response if it contains no `web_search_call` or no usable HTTP(S) `url_citation`. It never extracts URLs from model prose. Duplicate citation URLs are removed, titles are retained when supplied, and the shared DSH web service applies the final `maxResults` truncation.

dsh-web-search-openai README · Relationship to `dsh-pharma-product-facts`：This bundle supplies URL discovery only. It does not change the conversation model, force the model to call `web_search`, fetch cited page bodies, or validate medical claims. The companion pharma bundle can consume its results through the stable DSH `web_search` tool, then independently fetch and validate CDE/NMPA evidence before finalizing an answer:

```text
pharma-product-facts -> DSH web_search -> openai-responses
  -> candidate official URLs -> pharma source validation -> final answer
```

dsh-web-search-openai README · Relationship to `dsh-pharma-product-facts`：Either bundle can run independently. `dsh-pharma-product-facts` works with any usable DSH search provider; install the companion with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Alberssssss/dsh-pharma-product-facts-plugin
```

dsh-web-search-openai README · Configuration：The bundle owns two patch operations: it inserts the provider row and replaces the existing `web` row's `searchProvider`. A profile layer can override either row:

```yaml
- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: openai-responses

dsh-web-search-openai README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | omitted | Literal key; prefer `apiKeyEnv` so no secret enters configuration. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `GPT_API_KEY` | Credential reference resolved for every search through `ctx.credentials`, with launch-environment fallback when that service is absent. |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.openai.com/v1` | Responses API base; `/responses` is appended. The shipped bundle explicitly overrides it with the imedloop proxy. |
| `model` | required | Model that supports native Responses Web Search. The shipped bundle selects `gpt-5.6-sol`. |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `4096` | Positive-integer output cap for the auxiliary Responses request. The imedloop route can spend more than 1024 tokens on reasoning before emitting cited text. |

dsh-web-search-openai README · Configuration：The key is resolved for every request, so replacing `GPT_API_KEY` in the DSH credential store affects the next search without rebuilding this package. The exact secret-free request body is appended as `web/openai-search-llm-request` when an initiating DSH agent exists; headers and credentials are never logged.

dsh-web-search-openai README · Security and failures：- Credential-bearing requests set `redirect: "error"`; a 3xx response is rejected before its `Location` is contacted.
- Caller cancellation covers credential resolution, network dispatch, and response parsing and surfaces as `WEB_ABORTED`.
- Missing credentials surface as `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`; network, HTTP, malformed-body, missing-search, and missing-citation failures surface as `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR`.
- Only HTTP(S) URL citations enter `sources`; malformed and local schemes are discarded.
- Provider responses remain external model output. Consumers such as `pharma-product-facts` must still fetch and validate the cited primary source before treating a snippet or answer as evidence.

dsh-web-search-openai README · What the model sees：A separate Responses model receives `Search the web for the following query and cite the sources you use:\n<query>` and the native `web_search` tool declaration. This auxiliary request is not part of the conversation model's context.

dsh-web-search-openai README · Token effect：Every search incurs a separate Responses model request; `maxOutputTokens` caps its generated output. Native Web Search usage and billing remain properties of the configured endpoint and account.
dsh-web-search-openai README · KV Cache effect：The search request is independent of the conversation request cache. The instruction and tool declaration are stable, while the query changes per call.

dsh-web-search-openai README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- The Responses API does not expose a portable result-count control used here; DSH enforces `maxResults` after mapping citations.
- URL citation annotations provide URL and title but no portable source snippet, so `snippet` is absent.
- The package does not add a fetch provider. It changes only `web_search` and leaves source retrieval to the existing consumer workflow.
- Native search may cite a dynamically rendered page that exposes no extractable body. Consumers that require primary-source text must locate a directly fetchable document or report the evidence gap.
- A proxy may accept Responses text generation while rejecting native Web Search. The provider fails loudly instead of degrading to uncited prose.
